content.title: Last-Iterate Equilibrium Learning in Symmetric Congestion Games under Semi-Bandit Feedback
content.abstract: We study last-iterate learning of mixed Nash equilibria in atomic symmetric congestion games under resource semi-bandit feedback, where players observe both the costs and the loads of their selected resources. For strictly increasing latency functions, the restriction of the potential function to symmetric marginal profiles is strongly convex. However, players' independent stochastic updates need not preserve this symmetry without explicit synchronization.
